objective: Identify which mechanisms cause the remaining synthetic mobile loading and hero motion failures before another product change.
question: Which isolated mechanism has repeatable causal evidence strong enough to justify the next optimization?

entities.statement: Route-scoped responsive preloads reduce mobile cold readiness relative to the same build with preload insertion blocked.
entities.evidence: Preload was slower in all five paired rounds.

entities.statement: CSS filter and shadow raster work is the primary cause of early hero frame misses.
entities.evidence: Direction changed across paired rounds and final-loop p75 was unchanged.

entities.statement: Painting the decorative background is the primary cause of early hero frame misses after its simulation moved to a worker.
entities.evidence: No-background paint improved assembly in three of four paired rounds and tied once; final-loop p95 improved or tied in all four.

entities.statement: Observed differences are dominated by run order or host variance and do not identify a promotable mechanism.
entities.evidence: Control p95 varied substantially and host load reached 11.24, but paired no-background direction remained consistent.

entities.statement: A visually equivalent background with fewer painted pixels or cheaper compositing can retain the design while improving early and final-loop scheduling.
No explicit preload or preloading only the assembled high-priority image will avoid the contention caused by preloading all five images.

lifecycle_posture.evidence_confidence: moderate for paired fixture direction; low for absolute timing and physical-device generalization
lifecycle_posture.commitment_confidence: high commitment to unchanged acceptance limits; no commitment to a mechanism
residue: Headless Chromium does not certify physical GPU presentation
CPU throttling may affect workers differently

challenge_contract.challenge_response: retain counterevidence and demote unsupported mechanism claims
challenge_contract.resolution_gate: Promote only a repeated directional effect that survives the full unchanged benchmark and fidelity checks.
blocking_questions: Does the physical Windows laptop reproduce the selected mechanism?

claim_bound: Diagnostic interventions may identify a candidate cause; they do not establish field performance, GPU presentation, or release readiness.
